faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our driving license services.

questions.q: Is the driving license legally valid?
questions.a: Yes, absolutely. We work with registered driving schools and authorities across the EU. The driving license you receive is 100% legal, registered in official databases, and valid throughout the European Union.
We currently support applications primarily for Germany, France, and other select EU member states. Your EU driving license is valid in all EU and EEA countries.

questions.q: What happens during a police check?
questions.a: Since your license is officially registered and recorded in the government databases, any police check will be successful. The document is authentic and legally acquired.

questions.q: How long does the process take?
questions.a: The standard processing time is between 14 to 21 working days, depending on the authorities. We also offer an express service that can shorten this to 5 to 7 working days.

questions.q: Do I have to take an exam?
questions.a: In most cases, we can structure the process so that no new theoretical or practical exam is required, especially if it's an exchange or an extension. We utilize legal frameworks within EU directives.

questions.q: Which documents do I need to submit?
questions.a: Normally, we need a copy of your current ID (ID card or passport), a biometric passport photo, and a digital signature. In special cases, proof of residence may be required.

questions.q: Can I exchange my foreign license?
questions.a: Yes, we specialize in exchanging non-EU driving licenses for a full German or EU license without the usual bureaucratic hassle.
Yes. We use advanced encryption and GDPR-compliant databases (Supabase) to store your information. Your data is never sold to third parties and is used exclusively for the license application.

questions.q: What if I have points in the driving register?
questions.a: We can also advise you in cases where your point account is high or a driving ban is imminent. There are often legal ways to restore mobility through an EU driving license.

questions.q: Does your service help with an MPU order?
questions.a: Yes, we have strategies for customers who have been ordered to undergo a Medical-Psychological Assessment (MPU). We help you get back behind the wheel legally without having to take the MPU in Germany.

questions.q: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.a: We accept secure payments via Bank Transfer, Credit Card, and selected Cryptocurrencies for maximum privacy. Payments are typically split: an upfront fee and a final payment upon successful registration.

questions.q: What is the advantage of an EU license?
questions.a: An EU license must be recognized in every member state without exchange. It offers maximum flexibility and protection against arbitrary withdrawal measures in individual countries.
Delivery is handled discreetly and securely via registered mail or courier service directly to your specified address. You will receive a tracking number.

questions.q: Can I also obtain truck or bus licenses?
questions.a: Yes, we support all classes from A (motorcycle) to B (car) to C (truck) and D (bus), including the necessary modules like Code 95 for commercial drivers.
